title: Grant Transparency Act of 2023
official_summary:
Grant Transparency Act of 2023

This act establishes transparency requirements for notices of funding opportunity in applications for competitive grants awarded by federal agencies, excluding the Government Accountability Office.

Specifically, each notice of funding opportunity issued by an agency for a competitive grant must include

  • a description of any rating system and evaluation and selection criteria the agency uses to assess applications for the grant;
  • a statement of whether the agency uses a weighted scoring method and a description of any such method that it uses for the grant, including the amount by which the agency weighs each criterion; and
  • any other qualitative or quantitative merit-based approach the agency uses to evaluate an application for the grant.

Additionally, the Office of Management and Budget must develop relevant data elements to ensure common reporting by each agency with respect to such grant applications.

summary.headline: Federal agencies must explain in grant announcements how they score and choose applicants for competitive grants.
summary.what_it_does: When a federal agency announces a competitive grant, the announcement must now describe its rating system and the criteria it uses to judge applications. It must say whether it uses weighted scoring and, if so, how much each criterion counts. It must also describe any other merit-based method used to evaluate applications. The Office of Management and Budget must create common data standards so agencies report on these grant applications the same way.

who_it_affects.group: Organizations and individuals that apply for federal competitive grants, such as nonprofits, universities, researchers, and local governments
who_it_affects.how: They will be able to see in advance how their applications will be rated and how much each scoring factor counts.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that award competitive grants (except the Government Accountability Office)
who_it_affects.how: They must include detailed scoring and selection information in each notice of funding opportunity.

who_it_affects.group: The Office of Management and Budget
who_it_affects.how: It must develop shared data elements so agencies report grant application information in a consistent way.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 11, 2024; the summary does not state a separate start date for the requirements.
